models_evaluated: Consortium for Safe Labor (CSL) PPH model (XGBoost)

links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) of original PPH model on local EHR data
links.effect: Original CSL model AUC 0.60 (95% CI 0.58–0.61) on 87,662 deliveries across eight hospitals, substantially reduced versus original development performance.
links.quote: The original CSL model demonstrated modest discrimination for predicting PPH with an AUC of 0.60 (95% CI, 0.58– 0.61).

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of locally refit model versus original model
links.effect: Refitting with XGBoost improved AUC from 0.60 to 0.75 (95% CI 0.74–0.76), though the refit model overestimated PPH risk across a range of predicted probabilities.
links.quote: Refitting a new model with XGBoost resulted in improved discrimination with an AUC of 0.75 (95% CI, 0.74–0.76).

links.effect: Original CSL model AUC 0.60 (95% CI, 0.58– 0.61) in external validation.
links.quote: The original CSL model demonstrated modest discrimination for predicting PPH with an AUC of 0.60 (95% CI, 0.58– 0.61).

links.effect: Refit model overestimated PPH risk across a range of predicted probabilities.
links.quote: Calibration analyses demonstrated that the refit model overestimated PPH risk across a range of predicted probabilities.

links.effect: Refit model AUC 0.75, but remained poorly calibrated and overestimated PPH risk.

screen.practice: local validation and refitting before deployment
screen.reason: The study conducts an external validation of an existing machine learning risk prediction model across an 8-hospital system and evaluates the practice of local model refitting/adaptation prior to clinical implementation.
